---
title: Override
language:
  navigation-site-label: "Navigation du site"
  navigation-section-label: "Navigation de section"
  navigation-toolbar-label: "Outils"
  navigation-page-label: "Navigation de page"
  navigation-breadcrumbs-label: "Fil d'Ariane"
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - 'nav.navbar[aria-label="Navigation du site"]'
          - 'nav#quarto-sidebar[aria-label="Navigation de section"]'
          - 'nav.quarto-secondary-nav[aria-label="Outils"]'
          - 'nav.page-navigation[aria-label="Navigation de page"]'
          - 'nav.quarto-page-breadcrumbs[aria-label="Fil d''Ariane"]'
        -
          - 'nav[aria-label="Site"]'
---

Authors can override every navigation label with `language:` metadata.
